name: Aloo Parwal Tofu
ingredients: 1 tomato, ginger, jeera and 1 tsp oil
steps: Heat oil with jeera and ginger.
Add parwal and potato; cover until tender.
note: Reduce potato further if a lower-carb meal is needed.
